Author: OOFGames
Name: Mini Games Emporium
Punchline: Host BAR 777 and other mini games with automated queue management.
Description: A plugin to manage mini game sessions, player queues, and Gil transactions. Use /minigames to open the main window.
Changelog:
- Fixed missing dispose calls for Deathroll Tournament events.
 Updated deathroll tournanment webhook with better info and image fixes.
- Added option to add players to tournament through chat messages.
- Added option to add players to BAR 777 queue for players context menu and chat context menu.
